Aap bilkul ek professional US Truck Dispatching landing page bana sakte hain! Aapki screenshot mein dikh raha hai ke aap GitHub par ek naya repository create kar rahe hain. Jab aapka repository ban jaye, toh aap apne code ko wahan push kar sakte hain aur GitHub Pages ka istemal karke apni website ko free mein live bhi kar sakte hain. 
Ek professional dispatching landing page mein niche diye gaye sections zaroor hone chahiye: 
🌟 Landing Page ke Zaroori Sections
  • Hero Section: Ek strong tagline (jaise: "Reliable US Truck Dispatching Services – Keep Your Trucks Moving"), Truck ya Logistics ki high-quality background image, aur ek bada call-to-action button (jaise: Get a Quote ya Sign Up Now). 
  • Our Services: Aap kya dispatch services de rahe hain (e.g., Load Matching, Rate Negotiation, Factoring Setup, Billing & Invoicing, 24/7 Support). 
  • Equipment Types: Aap kin trucks ko handle karte hain (jaise: Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, Step Deck, Power Only). 
  • Why Choose Us: Aapka commission rate kitna hai (e.g., 5% to 8%), no forced dispatch, aur behtareen gross per week ka wada. 
  • Contact Form / Registration: Owner-operators ke liye ek simple form jahan wo apna naam, email, phone number, aur equipment type enter kar sakein. 
💻 Landing Page Ka Complete HTML & CSS Code
Aap niche diye gaye code ko copy karke apni index.html file mein save kar sakte hain. Yeh responsive hai aur mobile aur desktop dono par behtareen dikhega.

            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            background: white;
        }
        .form-box {
            background: var(--light);
            padding: 45px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 600px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        }
        .form-box h2 { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 25px; color: var(--primary); }
        .form-group { margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .form-group label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; }
        .form-group input, .form-group select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 1rem;
            background: white;
        }
        .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus {
            outline: 2px solid var(--secondary);
        }
        .submit-btn {
            width: 100%;
            background-color: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            padding: 14px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .submit-btn:hover { background-color: #1e293b; }

        /* Floating WhatsApp Button */
        .whatsapp-float {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 30px;
            right: 30px;
            background-color: #25d366;
            color: white;
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 30px;
            box-shadow: 2px 2px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .whatsapp-float:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            background-color: #020617;
            color: #64748b;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 30px;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            border-top: 1px solid #1e293b;
        }

        /* Mobile Responsive adjustments */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .hero h1 { font-size: 2.2rem; }
            header { flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }
            nav a { margin: 0 10px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>

### 🚀 Upload Karne Ka Tareeqa (Steps):

1. **File Save Karein:** Is poore code ko copy karke computer par Notepad open karein, code paste karein aur file ko save karte waqt uska naam **`index.html`** rakhein. (Ensure karein ke format `.html` ho, `.txt` na ho).
2. **GitHub Par Upload Karein:** Jo screen aapke samne khuli hai, wahan blue color me likha hai **"choose your files"**. Us par click karein aur apni banayi hui `index.html` file ko select kar lein.
3. **Commit Karein:** File select karne ke baad, page ko thoda niche scroll karein aur green ya blue color ke **"Commit changes"** button par click kar dein. Aapki file live repository me add ho jayegi!

<FollowUp>
Jab aap index.html file commit kar lein, toh mujhe batayein taake main aapko **GitHub Pages** enable karne ka tarika bataoon jisse aapki website ka **free live link (URL)** ban jaye! Iske alawa:
* Kya aapko code me **Phone number** ya **WhatsApp link** change karwana hai?
* Ya website par apna koi **custom logo** lagana hai?
</FollowUp>
